title: Dashboard Wireframes v0 — Internal Unit Economics (Console) (text export)
content:
Text export of early wireframes (v0). This is NOT final UI. Intended to align Product + Eng + Finance on information architecture, default views, and drilldown behavior.

Assumptions for v0:
- Audience: internal only (Finance, Product, Eng)
- Primary KPI: blended $/1M output tokens
- Drilldowns: model (+ version/quant profile), region, customer tier
- Time grain: daily (default) with hourly available for recent windows (last 48h)
- Sensitive: cost data is internal; no customer-identifiable fields in UI (no customer IDs)

==========
SLIDE 1 — Title / context
==========
INTERNAL: Unit Economics Dashboard (v1)
Purpose: Make inference cost drivers visible + actionable.
Primary metric: blended $/1M output tokens.

Notes:
- “Blended” includes allocation decisions (idle capacity and shared overhead) per Finance methodology.
- Early versions will show a confidence/coverage indicator when dimensions are incomplete.

==========
SLIDE 2 — Information Architecture (IA)
==========
Nav:
- Console → Internal → Unit Economics

Page sections (top to bottom):
1) Filter bar + metric definition pill
2) KPI strip (current period summary)
3) Time series chart: blended $/1M output tokens
4) Breakdown tabs: Models | Regions | Customer tiers | Quantization profiles
5) Driver signals (secondary charts): cache hit rate, batching efficiency, avg output length, streaming %
6) Notes + data quality / freshness panel

==========
SLIDE 3 — Filter bar (global)
==========
Filter bar (left → right):
- Date range picker
  - quick presets: Last 24h, Last 7d (default), Last 30d, QTD, Custom
  - timezone selector (default: UTC; Finance may prefer America/Los_Angeles — open question)
- Time grain selector (Daily default; Hourly enabled when range <= 7d)
- Model selector (typeahead; multi-select)
  - default: “All models”
  - groupings: “Model family” vs “Exact model version” toggle (default: family)
- Region selector (multi-select)
  - default: “All regions”
  - note: region normalization required (cloud region vs internal colo label)
- Customer tier selector (multi-select)
  - default: “All tiers”
  - values: Self-serve | Dedicated | Private | Enterprise
- Quantization profile selector (multi-select)
  - default: “All profiles”
  - include a help tooltip: “Profiles represent runtime quantization settings tagged in telemetry.”
- Streaming toggle:
  - default: All
  - options: All | Streaming only | Non-streaming only

Right side:
- Compare toggle (OFF by default)
  - when ON: adds secondary date range (e.g., “previous period”)
- “Saved views” dropdown (v1.1?)
  - Finance wants “QTD all tiers” / “Hosted self-serve only” saved.

UX notes:
- Keep filter bar sticky as you scroll.
- Always show active filters as chips under the bar (so screenshots are self-explanatory).
- Avoid letting the user create “empty” combinations without clear messaging (e.g., selecting Private tier + region not supported).

==========
SLIDE 4 — Default landing state
==========
Default state (on first load):
- Date range: Last 7 days
- Grain: Daily
- Model: All
- Region: All
- Tier: All
- Quant profile: All
- Streaming: All

Rationale:
- Most users want trend + broad signal before slicing.

Landing KPI strip (top):
- Blended $/1M output tokens (current range)
- Output tokens (total)
- Total allocated cost ($)
- Coverage % (or “Data confidence”) + last updated time

Footnote behavior:
- “Blended $/1M output tokens = (allocated infra cost / output tokens) * 1,000,000”
- Link: “Methodology (Finance)” (internal)

==========
SLIDE 5 — KPI strip wireframe (text)
==========
[KPI] Blended $/1M output tokens:  $X,XXX   (▲/▼ vs comparison)
[KPI] Output tokens:  X.XXB
[KPI] Total allocated cost:  $X,XXX,XXX
[KPI] Data confidence:  High / Medium / Low
      - tooltip: completeness checks, missing dimension rate, ingestion delay

Formatting notes:
- Use $ with comma separators; allow small decimals if needed (design guideline pending).
- For $/1M tokens, round to nearest whole dollar by default; show more precision on hover.

==========
SLIDE 6 — Primary chart (time series)
==========
Time series chart: Blended $/1M output tokens
- Line chart
- If comparison ON: show dashed line for comparison period
- If confidence is low: show shaded “uncertain” overlay on impacted days/hours

Hover tooltip fields:
- Date/time bucket
- Blended $/1M output tokens
- Output tokens
- Allocated cost
- Cache hit rate (avg)
- Batching efficiency (avg)
- Avg output length
- Streaming %

Chart controls:
- “Normalize” toggle? (e.g., index to 100 at start) — probably v1.1
- “Annotations” from incidents/backfills? (v1.1; but we should leave space)

==========
SLIDE 7 — Breakdown section (tabbed)
==========
Tabs:
- Models
- Regions
- Customer tiers
- Quantization profiles

Each tab has:
- Top-N table (default: Top 10 by output tokens; sortable)
- Small inline bar (share of tokens)
- Secondary metric columns (cache hit, batching, avg output length)
- A “drilldown” action: click row to open a detail panel or navigate to a scoped view

Table columns (common):
- Dimension name (model family, region, tier, quant profile)
- Blended $/1M output tokens
- Output tokens
- Allocated cost
- Cache hit rate (avg)
- Batching efficiency (avg)
- Avg output length
- Streaming %
- Data confidence (icon)

Notes:
- No customer ID column.
- No raw infrastructure identifiers.

==========
SLIDE 8 — Models tab (Top-N)
==========
Models tab table:
Row examples (placeholder):
- llama-3.1-70b-instruct
- qwen2.5-72b-instruct
- mistral-large

Model grouping toggle (within Models tab):
- Group by: Model family (default)
- Group by: Exact model version

When grouped by exact version:
- show version string (e.g., “llama-3.1-70b-instruct@2025-01-14”) plus quant profile if present

Wireframe behaviors:
- Clicking a row:
  - navigates to the same dashboard with filter “Model = <selected>” and opens a right-side “Detail” drawer

Detail drawer content (v0):
- Mini time series for selected model
- Top regions for this model
- Top tiers for this model
- Notes: “Recent rollouts / quantization changes” (manual for now; automation later)

==========
SLIDE 9 — Regions tab (Top-N)
==========
Region table row label rules:
- Use canonical region names (e.g., us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1)
- For internal colos: map to canonical (e.g., “iad-colo-1” → “us-east-1”) or separate category “colo-*” if Finance needs it.

Region detail drawer:
- Mini trend
- Top models in region
- Top tiers in region

Open question:
- Some Finance reporting is “Americas / EMEA / APAC” rollup. Should we provide a “region group” dimension? (v1.1)

==========
SLIDE 10 — Customer tier tab
==========
Tier values (proposal):
- Self-serve
- Dedicated
- Private
- Enterprise

Notes:
- Tier mapping must be stable + auditable; tooltip should reference source-of-truth (billing plan vs contract metadata).
- Edge cases: resellers, pilots, credits. In v0 wireframes, show “Unknown” tier bucket if mapping fails.

Tier detail drawer:
- Mini trend
- Top models within tier
- Top regions within tier
- A highlighted warning if “Unknown > 0.5% of tokens”

==========
SLIDE 11 — Quantization profiles tab
==========
Quantization profile table rows:
- fp16
- bf16
- int8
- int4
- awq-int4 (example)

Notes:
- Quant profile values must be allowlisted (avoid cardinality explosion).
- Need a quick explanation on hover: “Profile = runtime execution/weight quantization configuration applied at serving.”

Detail drawer:
- Mini trend
- Associated models (top 5)
- Latency/quality guardrail link (v1.1)

==========
SLIDE 12 — Driver signals section (below breakdown)
==========
Purpose: show “why” cost moved.

Layout:
- 2x2 mini charts (or stacked rows) for:
  1) Cache hit rate (KV/prefix)
  2) Batching efficiency (utilization proxy)
  3) Avg output length (tokens/req)
  4) Streaming % (share of output tokens in streaming responses)

Interactions:
- These charts should reflect global filters.
- Hover sync with main time series (nice-to-have).

Metric definition tooltips (draft):
- Cache hit rate: “% of requests served with KV/prefix cache hits (weighted by tokens)”
- Batching efficiency: “effective batch utilization (weighted), higher = better”
- Avg output length: “output_tokens / requests”
- Streaming %: “output tokens emitted via streaming / total output tokens”

==========
SLIDE 13 — Data quality / freshness panel
==========
Panel content:
- “Last updated: <timestamp>”
- “Freshness SLO: hourly completeness”
- “Missing dimension rate (last 24h): region X%, tier Y%, quant_profile Z%”
- “Known issues” link

If confidence is low:
- show a callout banner at top of page:
  - “Data incomplete for the selected range. Some output tokens may be undercounted (streaming path). See details.”

==========
SLIDE 14 — Empty states + error states
==========
Empty state (no data):
- “No data for the selected filters.”
- Show suggestions:
  - broaden date range
  - clear model/version filters
  - check tier mapping

Error state (API failure):
- “Dashboard data failed to load.”
- show request id + retry button

Partial data:
- “Showing partial results” label with explanation and link to runbook.

==========
SLIDE 15 — Drilldown navigation patterns (v0 proposal)
==========
Pattern A: Full navigation (preferred)
- Clicking a row updates global filters and reloads page with scoped view.
Pros: easy to share URL; consistent query model.
Cons: reload may feel heavy.

Pattern B: Side drawer only
- Clicking a row opens details without changing global filter.
Pros: fast; exploratory.
Cons: hard to share; inconsistent state.

Proposal:
- Do both:
  - Single click row → update global filters + open drawer
  - “Open in new tab” action available in drawer header

==========
SLIDE 16 — Comparison mode (time range)
==========
When Compare ON:
- Secondary date range selector appears (“Compare to”) with presets:
  - Previous period
  - Previous week
  - Previous month

Table changes:
- Add a delta column: “Δ $/1M” and “Δ %”
- Sorting defaults remain by tokens; user can sort by delta.

Guardrails:
- If ranges have different number of days, show warning.
- If confidence differs between ranges, show warning.

==========
SLIDE 17 — Rounding + presentation guidelines (draft)
==========
Display:
- $/1M output tokens:
  - show as $X,XXX
  - hover: $X,XXX.XX
- Tokens:
  - show as 12.3M / 4.56B with unit suffix
- Percentages:
  - 0–100% with 1 decimal on hover

Warnings:
- Users will over-interpret small movements; prefer showing confidence badges and coverage stats.
- Consider adding “minimum token threshold” in tables (e.g., hide rows with < 0.5% tokens) to reduce noise.

==========
SLIDE 18 — Permissions / access (wireframe note)
==========
This page is internal-only.

UX:
- If user lacks permission:
  - show “You don’t have access to Unit Economics.”
  - link to request access (internal form)
  - include RBAC group name(s)

Auditability:
- Access should be logged.

==========
SLIDE 19 — Notes / open questions
==========
Open questions to resolve before v1 UI locks:
1) Default timezone (UTC vs Finance timezone). Consider a per-user preference.
2) Confidence indicator calculation + thresholds (what triggers Low?).
3) How to represent idle capacity allocation in explanations without overwhelming.
4) Model naming: marketing names vs internal IDs; need a stable alias layer.
5) Should we include a “Route” dimension in v1? (could be too high-cardinality + confusing)
6) Should we ship “Model version” drilldown in v1 or v1.1?
7) Comparison mode: is it required for Finance day-1 or can it wait?

==========
SLIDE 20 — Implementation notes (for Eng)
==========
API needs (draft):
- timeseries endpoint: metric=$per_1m_output_tokens, group_by=time, filters (model, region, tier, quant_profile, streaming)
- breakdown endpoint: metric=$per_1m_output_tokens, group_by=<dimension>, sort_by=tokens, limit=10, include secondary signals
- include “coverage/confidence” fields in responses

Performance:
- Expect frequent filter changes; add caching for common views (Last 7d, All).
- Table and chart should load progressively (don’t block on driver signals).

Instrumentation:
- Track adoption: page views, filter changes, compare usage.

==========
Appendix — Quick sketch (ASCII)
==========
[ Filter bar: Date | Grain | Model | Region | Tier | Quant | Streaming | Compare ]
[ KPIs:  $/1M  | Tokens | Allocated $ | Confidence | Last updated ]
[ Line chart: blended $/1M over time ]
[ Tabs: Models | Regions | Tiers | Quant ]
[ Top-N table (sortable, click to drill) ]
[ Driver signals charts (cache, batching, avg out len, streaming %) ]
[ Data quality panel + links ]

End of v0 export.

Changelog:
- 2025-01-09: Initial structure + default filters
- 2025-01-15: Added confidence panel + comparison mode sketch
- 2025-01-23: Added quantization profiles tab + driver signals section
